title: Mandy Gonzalez the woman that you are!!!! #Broadway #SunsetBoulevard ...
transcript: I literally never do this. I always wait, like, a day to record my thoughts on a show. But I just saw Mandy Gonzalez in Sunset Boulevard, and I simply have to talk about it immediately, because what she's doing up on that stage is unreal, and it is completely different from Nicole Scherzinger's take on the character. Now, listen, I love Nicole's Norma, so I am not saying any of this as a knock on her performance, but Nicole's Norma is out of 10, like, the entire show. The second she walks out on that stage, you are like, oh, this woman is batshit insane. But also, she's so captivating, and I can't take my eyes off her. Whereas Mandy begins the show so much more subdued, and we actually kind of see her come apart throughout the course of the show, which is just such a cool take. I think because of that approach, her normal feels so much more grounded and real. And then you add on top of that, this incredible voice. Like, Mandy Gonzalez's nickname is The Beast. And if you see her in the show, you will understand why. She has this powerful, booming voice, which gives her Norma such a presence. And she absolutely devours with one look and as if we never said goodbye. Truly, like, you need to go see it. It. It will change your life. Mandy plays the role of Norma Desmond every Tuesday, I believe. But this week, She's actually on all week through Saturday. So if you do want to see her as Norma, now is truly the perfect time. And then Sunday we are getting our first and and maybe only Caroline Bowman Norma performance, which I am so excited for, and I will absolutely be there. I will post a breakdown of all of my thoughts on all three Normas. But I wanted to make this video in the meantime to tell you to go see Mandy, because the work that she is doing in the show is not to be missed.
